City of Chicago
                                                                     O2022-1201
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 4/27/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Scott, Jr. (24)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 4-1 at 2116-2118 S Albany
                              Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                       ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the M1-2,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 4-1 in the area bound by:

      a line 300 feet north of and parallel to the alley next north of and parallel to West Cermak
      Road; South Albany Avenue; a line 250 feet north of and parallel to the alley next north
      of and parallel to West Cermak Road; and the alley next west of and parallel to South
      Albany Avenue,

to those ofa B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                           Michael Scott Jr.
                                                           Alderman, 24''' Ward




Common Address:
2116-2118 S. Albany Avenue
